Optimal.Notes: The 40 Hz refresh and 40 fps cap is the sweet spot for this game on Deck — smooth enough for tracking animals and aiming, with medium textures and foliage preserving the game's atmosphere. FSR at 1024x640 keeps the image clean while giving the GPU headroom.

profiles.Summary: theHunter: Call of the Wild is a demanding open-world hunting simulation that sits just above the Steam Deck's comfortable performance zone, requiring lowered settings and FSR to achieve stable frame rates. The game is rated Playable on Deck with ProtonDB gold-tier community confidence, and runs well enough for an enjoyable experience at reduced quality settings.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Steam Deck player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum/recommended requirements (GTX 660–760 class, placing the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU roughly in range at low-medium settings) and the open-world nature of the game. On your first run, check frame rate in a dense forest area — if it dips below 30 fps in the Optimal profile, drop to Max Battery settings or reduce Foliage Quality first.

MaxBattery.Notes: Rendering at 960x600 with FSR upscaling keeps GPU load minimal; the 8W TDP cap and locked 30 fps target maximize session length. The slow-paced nature of hunting makes 30 fps very acceptable here.
